title: Agents: Upload PDF, DOCX, TXT and CSV files as knowledge
description: Chatbase trains on PDF, TXT, DOC and DOCX up to 20 MB each (https://www.chatbase.co/docs/user-guides/chatbot/data-sources.md) and Voiceflow imports PDF, DOCX and CSV/XLSX tables where each row becomes a chunk (https://www.voiceflow.com/docs/documentation/build/importing-data-sources.md). Our Knowledge tab only takes Docs pages, up to 20 URLs and Chat saved replies (knowledgeConfigSchema in lib/agents-config.ts); there is no file input (verified in the browser). Price lists and manuals usually live in PDFs. First scope: upload files to an agent (reuse the Docs upload storage), extract text server side, chunk and index them next to URLs for search_knowledge, show size, status and re-upload, with a per-workspace size cap.

title: Agents: Crawl a whole site or sitemap with include and exclude patterns
description: Chatbase crawls a website or sitemap and auto-resyncs weekly (https://www.chatbase.co/docs/user-guides/chatbot/data-sources.md); Voiceflow manages sitemaps with include/exclude patterns and a refresh schedule (https://www.voiceflow.com/docs/documentation/build/importing-data-sources.md). We allow 20 single URLs (AGENT_MAX_URLS) re-synced daily. A team moving from an old help center on another domain has hundreds of pages. First scope: add a site or sitemap URL, discover pages up to a cap (e.g. 500) with include/exclude path patterns, fetch through safeFetch with a crawl budget per cron tick, show the page list with status, and re-sync weekly.

title: Agents: Add WhatsApp as a channel for the agent
description: Chatbase deploys agents to WhatsApp (with templates and Coexistence), Messenger, Instagram and Slack (https://www.chatbase.co/docs/llms.txt) and Fin answers on WhatsApp, SMS and Slack (https://fin.ai/updates). Agents only run on a Chat widget, /a/<handle>, the API and Flow (AGENT_USAGE_CHANNELS). For small teams in LatAm WhatsApp is where customers write. First scope: connect a WhatsApp Business Cloud number to an agent, map each phone number to an agent conversation, run runAgent on inbound messages, reply within the 24 h window, and hand off to the Chat inbox (shared with the Chat WhatsApp channel idea) with the same handoff rules.

title: Agents: Run multi-turn simulations with an AI customer and replay real conversations
description: Fin Simulations play a full conversation with an AI customer, mock connector outputs and judge the result; Batch Test replays real conversations (https://fin.ai/updates/simulations-for-procedures, https://fin.ai/updates). Voiceflow tests support AI-simulated users with success criteria and assertions on tool calls (https://www.voiceflow.com/docs/documentation/measure/tests.md). Our tests (lib/agents-tests.ts) are one question plus an expected behavior, which does not cover booking or qualification flows. First scope: a test can be a persona plus a goal; an LLM plays the customer for up to N turns in dry run and the judge checks the goal and which tools were called; plus 'Replay last 20 conversations' that reruns real visitor messages against the current instructions and highlights answers that changed.

title: Agents: Score every conversation for sentiment and quality with AI
description: Fin rates every conversation with a CX Score without surveys and detects sentiment and urgency (https://community.intercom.com/product-updates/a-new-era-of-insights-has-arrived-10513); Chatbase shows sentiment and CSAT (https://www.chatbase.co/docs/user-guides/chatbot/analytics.md). Our Analytics tab (lib/agents-analytics.ts) has resolution, handoffs, tool errors, keyword topics and thumbs, which few visitors click. First scope: when a conversation goes idle, a cheap model call scores sentiment, whether the question was answered and a 1 to 5 quality score with a one-line reason; show averages and a worst-conversations list in Analytics and feed the existing alerts.

title: Agents: Show buttons and short forms in the chat to capture leads
description: Chatbase has Collect leads, Collect data, custom buttons and suggested messages as actions (https://www.chatbase.co/docs/llms.txt). Our agents ask for email and company in free text and then call crm_upsert_contact; visitors skip or mistype it and the SDR template loses leads. First scope: a collect_info tool the agent can call with fields (email, name, phone, company, a select) that renders a small form in the Chat widget and the public page, validates on the client, returns the values to the agent and saves them to the CRM contact, plus quick-reply buttons the agent can offer.

title: Agents: Connect MCP servers as tools
description: Fin added MCP connectors including a Zapier MCP that reaches thousands of apps (https://fin.ai/updates) and Voiceflow has an MCP tool (https://www.voiceflow.com/docs/documentation/build/tools/overview.md). Our tools are the suite tools plus http_request with secret headers (lib/agent-tools.ts), so calling a third-party system means hand-writing HTTP calls. First scope: add an MCP server URL with an optional secret header (reuse agent secrets), list its tools, enable specific tools per agent, run them through the existing logging, dry-run simulation and approval flow, and block private hosts with safeFetch.

title: Agents: Add step-by-step procedures the agent follows for a specific task
description: Fin Procedures combine natural-language steps with deterministic if/else, code and approval steps (https://fin.ai/help/en/articles/13976187-fin-procedures-explained); Chatbase has Procedures (https://chatbase.co/docs/user-guides/chatbot/procedures/procedures-overview.md) and Voiceflow mixes playbooks with canvas workflows. Our agent has one instruction block, so a refund or reschedule flow depends on the model following prose. First scope: named procedures with a trigger description and ordered steps (ask for a field, call a tool, check a condition, hand off); the runtime injects the active procedure and tracks the current step per conversation, and Analytics shows completion per procedure.

title: Agents: Export, import and duplicate an agent with its configuration
description: Chatbase lets you duplicate agents and Voiceflow exports environments (https://www.chatbase.co/docs/user-guides/chatbot/settings.md, https://www.voiceflow.com/docs/documentation/deploy/environments/overview.md). There is no way to copy an agent here: to try new instructions safely you rebuild it by hand, and there is no backup before a big edit. First scope: Duplicate in the agent menu, and export/import as JSON with instructions, knowledge selection, tools config, handoff, guardrails and tests (secrets excluded and listed as missing on import).

title: Agents: Fall back gracefully on the public page and API when the model fails
description: On the Chat channel a model failure falls back to the keyword bot (lib/agents-chat.ts), but on /a/<handle> the visitor sees the owner-facing error asking to load credits in the Vercel AI Gateway or choose a model in Instructions > Model (reproduced in the benchmark with ai_no_credits). Fin and Chatbase never show configuration errors to customers. First scope: map provider errors to a generic visitor message on the public page and API, offer handoff with an email field, record the error so the existing alerts notify the owner, and optionally retry with a fallback model.
